messages.message: My payment is failing when trying to renew our subscription.

I investigated your payment attempt. The card processor rejected the charge with an Address Verification System (AVS) mismatch. Could you verify if the billing address in your account matches your card statement?
I tried re-submitting with the card number again, but it was declined again. Does the billing zip code really have to match the physical office?
Yes, the card issuing bank strictly enforces postal code matching. If your company recently moved or uses a headquarters address, updating it in the billing portal will clear the hold immediately.
Ah, our corporate office recently moved! I updated the billing address to 402 Lakeview Blvd and it went through!
Excellent! The payment has cleared and your Enterprise plan is fully active. I have noted this resolution on your account.
Please give me instructions one step at a time whenever we troubleshoot.
Understood, Rahul! I will always provide step-by-step guidance, one single action at a time so you can proceed comfortably.
Hello, our corporate card payment is failing again at renewal. Can you check what is happening?

Hello Rahul Sharma, I see your payment is failing again.

Based on our previous conversation, this issue was resolved when we updated your billing address to match your card issuing statement.

Let's check this step-by-step:
**Step 1:** Please navigate to **Billing Settings > Payment Methods** and verify if the billing address matches your card statement.

recalledMemoriesUsed.content: Payment issue was successfully resolved by updating the corporate billing address to 402 Lakeview Blvd to match the credit card issuing bank statement.
Customer preference: Prefers step-by-step instructions presented one sequential action at a time without complex jargon.

messages.message: My MFA codes are showing invalid even though I just entered the current number from Google Authenticator.
This typically happens due to clock drift on the mobile device. In your Authenticator app, go to Settings -> Time correction for codes -> Sync now. That will synchronize the tokens.
That fixed it! Thank you so much for the quick help.
